subject: Head-to-head RFP: stipend allocation arbitration
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novumsoft.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Head-to-head RFP: stipend allocation arbitration

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week. We're running a tight bakeoff across three vendors for our inference stack and procurement asked me to clarify the stipend / credit support envelope. One of the other vendors has offered a fairly aggressive credit package (significant compute credits + priority onboarding) that is shaping the selection conversation.

Can Redwood flex on the initial eval stipend? The RFP team is looking for at least $40k in runtime credits + a short burst pool to validate throughput at our 1M token/day profile. Attached is the latest RFP doc (Novum_RFP_v3.pdf) so you can see the acceptance window and evaluation criteria.

If we can get a clear, written stipend proposal and a simple SOW for the pilot, we can move to procurement review this week. Do you have an internal process for arbitration when competitive offers appear in a bakeoff?

Best,
Samantha Lee
Sr. Manager, Platform Procurement
NovumSoft
Attachments: Novum_RFP_v3.pdf (application/pdf, 1.2MB)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novumsoft.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Head-to-head RFP: stipend allocation arbitration

Hi Samantha — appreciate the transparency and for sharing the RFP.

Short answer: yes, we can structure a competitive stipend but it will be conditional. The approach we've used successfully in similar bakeoffs is:
- Committed evaluation window (we ask for a 6-week active evaluation period)
- Shareback clause: a short summary of test results so we can improve the onboarding and model selection (non-IP, aggregate metrics only)
- Signature of a short SOW + MAA before credits are provisioned.

Proposed package (subject to final approval):
- $50,000 runtime credit allocation (usable across our hosted and dedicated evaluation tiers)
- One-time sandbox burst pool of 200k tokens for ramp testing
- SOW draft and stipend plan attached for procurement review (redwood-stipend-plan-v2.xlsx, SOW_draft.pdf).

If procurement is comfortable with those conditions and the timeline in your RFP, I can escalate for approval today. I cc'd Ben and Marissa to flag any commercial constraints.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-stipend-plan-v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), SOW_draft.pdf (application/pdf, 65KB)

Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: internal: NovumSoft bakeoff — stipend ask (need approval)

Team — forwarding Novum's ask. Summary: they want a competitive stipend (they signaled another vendor is offering an aggressive credit package). I proposed $50k runtime + a 200k token burst, conditional on SOW + MAA + 6-week evaluation.

Questions for ops/legal/commercial:
- Is $50k within our discretionary stipend band for mid-market RFPs?
- Any restrictions on burst/sandbox pools that would cause cost or support issues?
- Any procurement redlines we should preempt (data retention, audit scope)?

Ben: can you advise on discretionary credit ceilings?
Marissa: if you sign off commercially, I'll confirm with Samantha and push DocuSign for the SOW.
Neha: FYI from ops side — will this require a dedicated onboarding engineer or is standard onboarding fine?

Thanks — attaching the draft SOW and the redwood stipend spreadsheet for reference.

Subject: Re: Head-to-head RFP: stipend allocation arbitration — approved proposal & next steps

Hi Samantha — good news. After a quick review with Commercial and Ops we've approved a modified package. Details below and next steps.

Approved stipend package:
- $40,000 runtime credit allocation (applied as account credit once SOW & MAA are counter-signed)
- Sandbox burst pool: 150k tokens for throughput validation
- Additional one-time 10% processing credit if NovumSoft executes the full pilot SOW and signs within 30 days of countersignature (to mirror priority vendor incentives).

Conditions:
- Standard MAA + short SOW countersigned (DocuSign link below). Credits will be provisioned after countersign and receipt of a purchase order.
- We ask NovumSoft to share an anonymized evaluation summary at the end of the pilot (aggregate metrics only).

DocuSign & next steps: please review and countersign the SOW here: https://www.docusign.com/neb/sign?env=prod&id=XYZ-NS-2026-0042
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-NS-2026-0042 (I've updated the pipeline stage to "Pilot — Stipend Approved").

Jordan will coordinate onboarding — cc'd. Ben and Marissa, thanks for the quick turnaround. Neha, Jordan will sync with you for required onboarding resources.

Samantha, happy to hop on a 15-min call to walk through logistics if that helps.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
